fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook and redfish early/late at Blind/Stump Pass and the beaches; pompano, whiting, jacks, Spanish mackerel. LEMON BAY: redfish schools Miserable Mile to Tom Adams; mangrove snapper and sheepshead at docks/pier; snook in the ICW. NEARSHORE: tarpon still showing on the Key; red/gag grouper and snapper 95–150 ft. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, soft plastics, pompano jigs.
redtide: FWC (Sep 18): K. brevis background in one Sarasota sample past week; no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next FWC report Fri Sep 25.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (enterococci ~10 CFU/100mL). Charlotte and Sarasota gulf beaches Good.
